annotations.title: Changes in agent tools since a date

description: List dated changes in agent tools and standards (new tools, renames, deprecations, breaking changes, new standards) since a date, optionally by kind or affected record. Useful for checking what changed after your training data. Public source URLs are kept; private sources appear as labels.

about.description: Affected record ID to filter changes, such as an app or protocol.

kinds.description: Change kinds to include; the array is an OR-list.

limit.description: Maximum changes, from 1 to 100; default is 20.

since.description: Inclusive event-date lower bound in YYYY-MM-DD; omitted uses the previous 90 days, not source confirmation dates.

name: headlesson_whats_new
title: Changes in agent tools since a date
